evidence.observation: Reboiler reads ~396 °C and is essentially frozen (396.2-396.5) while all other stages sit at 72-94 °C; physically implausible/stuck-high sensor
Slow uniform upward creep (~0.7 °C over 20 min) consistent with normal composition drift during takeoff
Reflux 0.15 L/h, distillate 0.36 L/h steady; FYI702 reported 2.73-3.9 inconsistent with FT703/FT704 ratio (~0.42), suggesting ratio channel misreporting
Pressure ~748-750 mbar and dP stable, no blockage or leak signature

args.missing_evidence: An independent reboiler temperature reading (or heater duty/setpoint) to confirm T701 is a stuck/drifted sensor rather than a real condition, and clarification of how FYI702 is computed; a distillate composition (GC) sample to address the separation question.
